integrity: The theorem is proved analytically from the quantile update, contraction, fixed-point increment inequalities and cellwise Wasserstein integration. No numerical experiment is used as proof. Literature comparison leaves an explicit residual risk that the target-quantile extension may be implicit folklore.
limitations: One-dimensional monotone contracting setting; the resource quantile is continuous, strictly increasing and bi-Lipschitz. No claim is made for atomic resource laws, nonmonotone maps, higher dimensions, or uniqueness among arbitrary atomic invariant measures.
title: Resource-quantization law for repulsive mean-field contractions
